summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements, including the addition of relative paths to the v4 spec and finer-grained read restrictions for loadTable responses. The community also addressed issues related to duplicated search results on the documentation site and ongoing integration work with Spark, particularly regarding versions 4.1 and 4.2.
highlights: Integration work and discussions related to Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on duplicated search results on iceberg.apache.org
Introduction of finer-grained read restrictions in loadTable
